review_scope: W18 read-only saved-project helper ownership audit

frozen_oracle.test_result: PASS: 10-case frozen oracle registered; stable source-hash assertions and targeted actual-source contract assertions pass.
frozen_oracle.test_limit: This contract test statically checks the actual serializer/restore windows; it does not execute the entire getConfig/loadConfigFromObj/project-open path. No native I/O or project file was used.

evidence.finding: buildProjectPayload obtains config from window.getConfig() and embeds that config directly in the envelope. The project envelope stores source paint path, canvas dimensions, layer data and selected-layer data, but it does not add zone part ownership metadata itself.
Project config remapping clones config and rewrites source-layer bindings. That operation would preserve unrelated JSON fields if present; it does not synthesize provenance.
getConfig explicitly serializes zone id, ordinary material/finish fields, mute state, source-layer links and encoded region/spatial masks. It does not serialize zone._aiPartProv.

loadConfigFromObj materializes zones field-by-field, preserves a present zone id (creating a new one only when absent), decodes region/spatial masks, preserves ordinary finish/mute fields, and does not restore _aiPartProv. Repeated same-name zones therefore remain distinguishable through persisted IDs, but any omitted ownership association cannot follow them across reload.

rememberPartRegion attaches private in-memory _aiPartProv to the live zone with serialized region, region-mask hash, part-mask hash, layout signature and element signature. It has no explicit source fingerprint or source-load generation field.

The application has a numeric source-load generation and committed source path/fingerprint accessors. These provide a real runtime source identity boundary; path alone is insufficient for same-path reload safety.

scenario_outcomes.ordinary_zone_state_and_mask_fields: Source contract retains them through the explicit config projection and restore materialization; full production roundtrip execution was outside this narrow harness.
scenario_outcomes.zone_identity_and_duplicate_names: Zone IDs are explicitly saved/restored, so duplicate names need not collide. No production project-file mutation was performed.
scenario_outcomes.part_provenance_cross_reload: FAIL / NOT PRESERVED: _aiPartProv is absent from both explicit save and load projections. A same-car saved project therefore cannot restore this helper's association from current config fields.
scenario_outcomes.ephemeral_edit_registry: Cross-reload registry restoration was not verified in this W18 harness. Do not treat private per-session registry state as persisted project ownership.
scenario_outcomes.rename_mute_forgery_stale_layout: No cross-reload provenance policy exists to exercise because provenance is dropped. Current zone fields retain name and muted state; provenance semantics require a separately specified validated persistence contract.

recommended_future_contract: Add a versioned, narrowly scoped part-ownership field to project zone config only after defining schema validation and fail-closed behavior; do not serialize arbitrary private helper objects wholesale.

Bind saved provenance to stable zone ID, canonical source identity/content fingerprint, part/region-mask hashes, layout signature and element signature. Recompute or validate runtime load generation after source commit rather than persisting an ephemeral generation as a durable identity.

Keep same-name zones distinct by stable zone IDs; define rename and mute semantics explicitly. On malformed, stale, unsupported or mismatched metadata, ignore ownership and require a fresh explicit selection instead of guessing from name/order/position.

Integrate through the project config serializer/loader boundary, preserving unrelated fields and existing mask codec behavior. Add a fresh saved-project fixture test that executes actual config capture, JSON encoding, restore and source identity validation before claiming round-trip support.
limitations: No full project open/save, native UI, server, provider or external I/O was invoked.
No assertions are made about user-visible UI behavior or actual zone painting after restore.
The proAI in-memory registry was not re-audited in this W18 task; prior session notes that it resets on page load remain a separate baseline observation, not a result of this test.
